Gauth is an all-in-one AI study platform, purpose-built for education. It combines step-by-step problem solving, interactive AI tutoring, and personalized study tools into one experience, so students can solve problems, understand concepts, and prepare more effectively. Since 2020, Gauth has surpassed 200 million downloads and supports a global community of students and lifelong learners.

Gauth Unlimited Digital Canvas 

## Gauth Unlimited Digital Canvas

Launched this week [...] ## Gauth Unlimited Digital Canvas

Launched this week

An AI tutor on an infinite whiteboard, not a chat thread

Gauth AI Course now runs on an Unlimited Digital Canvas: one continuous whiteboard where lessons unfold spatially instead of in a chat thread or slide deck. Chapters expand side by side as narration plays, board notes write out in sync with the AI voice, and you can zoom from the full concept map down to a single formula. Pause anytime to ask the AI Tutor, and it answers right on the board beneath your step. Generate a canvas lesson on any topic, then export it as a PDF or share a link.

results.title: Gauth Launches Unlimited Digital Canvas, Gives Students One Continuous Whiteboard to Visualize, Explore and Understand Complex Topics
results.content:
SINGAPORE, Oct. 1, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Gauth, the all-in-one study platform, today announced the launch of Unlimited Digital Canvas, a new whiteboard feature inside Gauth AI Course that works like a real tutor sitting next to a student. Instead of slides and separate chat messages, students and the AI Tutor now share one big board, writing and visually working through problems together in the same space. The update, now live across both history and math libraries, is the biggest change to how AI Course lessons are built and navigated since the product launched in July. [...] The Unlimited Digital Canvas restores a student's exact position and zoom level when they reopen a session and allows full lessons to be exported as a landscape PDF or shared via link. Contextual element-level Q&A, animation, and 3D assets for personalized lessons are planned for a future release. The Unlimited Digital Canvas is available now within Gauth AI Course.

About Gauth

Gauth is an industry-leading all-in-one AI study platform. Purpose-built for education, Gauth provides deep conceptual understanding and connects users with expert resources to solve complex academic challenges. For more information, please visit Gauth's official website and its TikTok.

Media Contact  
support@gauth.com

Cision

Cision

Privacy Dashboard [...] When a concept doesn't land, students can pause and ask the AI Tutor a question at any point. The AI Tutor writes its explanation directly onto the board beneath the student's current step, keeping its reasoning visible right where the student is working.

"We didn't design Unlimited Digital Canvas around the shape of a textbook page, we designed it around the shape of a student's thought process," commented Alan Wang, Gauth CTO. "Learning isn't linear and with this canvas, students can finally move through a topic by zooming into a single detail or panning out to see the whole concept, picking up exactly where they left off, with the AI Tutor working in tandem so as a student works through a problem, the tutor can see exactly where their thinking is and step in at that exact point."

results.title: Dealroom.co | Gauth launches unlimited digital canvas for AI-powered visual learning across maths and history
results.content:
Gauth, the AI study platform, has launched Unlimited Digital Canvas, a whiteboard feature that allows students and its AI Tutor to work through lessons together on one continuous space. The tool replaces traditional slides and chat-based learning with a shared board where both student and AI can write and solve problems visually. The canvas is now available in Gauth AI Course's history and math libraries. It displays chapters side-by-side in real time, enabling students to see connections across topics rather than switching between isolated slides. For complex subjects including maths, physics, and biology, the canvas offers 3D simulations and animations. Students can pause to ask questions at any point, with the AI Tutor writing explanations directly onto the board. The feature maintains [...] explanations directly onto the board.
